![Banner](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/Beautiful_Enchanted_Books/BH_BEB_header1.webp) 此模組旨在改善附魔書的外觀，現在每一本都各不相同！ 我們還添加了对超過 85 個模組的支持，包括：
展開 Ad Astra: Giselle Addon, Additional Additions, Additional Enchanted Miner, Alex's Caves, Alex's Caves: Stuff & Torpedoes, Alex's Mobs, Alexs Caves Exemplified, Allurement, Apotheosis, Apothic Enchanting, Apothic Spawners, Ars Additions, Ars Elemental, Ars Nouveau, Arthropofia, AzureLib, Backpacked, Better Archeology, Better End, BetterNether, Biome Makeover, Box of Horros, Celestisynth, Clutter, CoFH Core, Combat Roll, Corail Tombstone, Create, Create Stuff & Additions, Darker Depths, Death Knights, Deep Aether, Deeper and Darker, Draconic Evolution, EnderIO, Ensorcellation, Eternal Starlight, EvilCraft, Farmer's Delight, Fins and Tails, Forbidden Arcanus, Galosphere, gofish, Golden Foods, Hunter's Return, Jaden's Nether Expansion, Just a lot more enchantments, Just Enough Guns, Kobolds, Malum, Midnight, MineColonies, My Nether Delight, Mystical Agriculture, Mythic Charms, MythicBotania, Nature's Aura, Nether Depths Upgrade, Opposint Forge, Piglin Proliferation, Railcraft Reborn, Reliquary Reincarnations, Species, Spawner+, Spell Engine, Spell Power Attribute, Stalwart Dungeons, Stellarity, Supplementaries, Terramity, The Bumblezone, The Deep Void, The End of Herobrine, The Twilight Forest, The Undergarden, The Undead Revamp, Things, Too Many Bows, Trials Chambers, Unusual Fish, UtilitiX, Vampirism, Vein Mining, When Dungeons Arise and You're in Grave Danger and Yomai Style.
這是 Minecraft 社群無數次向作者提出的要求，因為這樣一來，它們就能彼此區分。為此，我們製作了這個超讚的資源包，為每本書提供了與主題相關的獨特紋理。 之前我們曾發佈過一個資源包，但自第一版以來，我們收到了無數將其轉換為模組且無需依賴其他模組的請求……現在，它終於問世了！本模組**絕對不需要**任何其他模組即可改變書籍外觀！ ### 需要伺服器與朋友一起遊玩嗎？

若要尋求卓越的伺服器託管服務，請直接選擇 **[BisectHosting](https://bisecthosting.com/lupin)**。當然，您可以安裝所有您想要的模組或整合包，他們的支援團隊也隨時為您提供協助。 **[使用優惠碼「Lupin」可享 25% 折扣！點擊此處！](https://bisecthosting.com/lupin)** ![Summary](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/Beautiful_Enchanted_Books/BH_BEB_summary.webp) 《美麗附魔書》的目標很簡單，就是為所有 Minecraft 書籍帶來嶄新外觀——它們不再會擁有千篇一律的無聊樣式！ 此外，它們會根據主題或用途呈現統一的風格基調，當然還具備獨特的設計元素，讓它們在眾多書籍中脫穎而出。我們相信您一定會喜歡這些特色！ ![FAQ](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/Beautiful_Enchanted_Books/BH_BEB_FAQ.webp) ### 是否支援伺服器？ ### 當然！記得使用模組和好友遊玩的最佳方式是搭配 BisectHosting，透過 **[點擊此連結即可享有 25% 折扣](https://bisecthosting.com/lupin)**。 ### 此模組能否用於整合包？ ### 當然可以！前提是僅在 Modrinth 或 CurseForge 上發佈。上傳至任何其他平台都將侵犯我們的權益，且完全不被允許。 不過，如果您考慮將其加入您的 Modrinth 或 CurseForge 整合包中，我們將深感感激。若您需要任何微調或有其他疑問，歡迎聯繫我們！ ![Screenshots 1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/pcqEicMM/images/4cf885c1731bc23979b344e9fa5e74f734e144a4.jpeg) ![Screenshots 2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/pcqEicMM/images/65ebec2ffdac4988f6610c69da0f9143ea7b92a1.jpeg) ![Screenshots 3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/pcqEicMM/images/84176cf1af8c5dc9569f6f460abc2e54a68a3fb0.jpeg) [![DISCORD](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/MultiRecipe/BH_Lupin_Discord.webp)](https://discord.gg/X8VY5WMbe4) .
